card.name: Stem cell transplant complication lists
card.fires_on: Commas, linking words and small spacing marks inside text about stem cell transplants, especially lists of transplant complications (graft-versus-host disease, veno-occlusive disease) and busulfan conditioning.

modes.label: Complication lists
modes.description: A comma or the word include inside a list of transplant-related complications.
modes.example: hepatic veno-occlusive disease (VOD) after reduced intensity conditioning<<,>> and steroid-requiring febrile syndrome

modes.label: Busulfan and conditioning
modes.description: Spacing or word parts in busulfan dosing or conditioning-regimen text.
modes.example: *Busulfan intravenous weight-based dose: 1 mg/kg every 6 hours for patients less than<< >>9 kg; 1.2 mg

card.writes: It promotes the word report, suggesting the next text may be a report of an event or finding.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting marks in transplant text, where a report of complications or events often follows.
